INSTRUCTION TO BIDDERS FOR PARTICIPATION Bidders are required to carefully read, understand, and comply with the complete Technical Sp ecifications, Bidder's Qualification Criteria, Acceptance Criteria and Note alongwith compliance sheet as detailed in Annexure, uploaded under the Buyer Specification Document (ATC). Bidde rs shall participate in the bid strictly in accordance with the provisions, conditions, and requir ements specified therein. Non-compliance with any of the stipulated criteria may result in reje ction of the bid. Bidder’s Qualification Criteria 1. Bidder should have their own helium quads. Details should be given along with the technica l bid. 2. Bidder should have their own bottling plant for filling helium gas. 3. Bidder has to submit PESO certificate of their installation and the quads along with the offe r. 4. Bidder should have their own test facility for detecting impurity components mentioned in t he technical specification. Along with the technical bid, the bidder should submit the details o f test facility (instruments and equipment) at their works. 5. A sample test certificate should be uploaded along with the offer. 6. The bidder shall fill, sign, stamp and upload enclosed Compliance Sheet mentioning the offe red specifications of Helium Gas along with relevant supporting documents during submission of tender. The bidder should agree to all the points mentioned in the ‘Compliance Sheet’ for t heir offer to be accepted for further evaluation. Acceptance Criteria:-

1. On receipt of the item at VECC site, the Helium gas will be checked for purity. The Helium g as composition shall comply with the requirements mentioned in this technical specification. Linde Make Multi-Component Detector will be used to check the gas quality (N2, O2 and H2O) at site. 2. The vendor shall submit a Test Report (which should contain the breakup of constituents) al ong with the supply of Helium gas. The type and Make of instrument (for the measurement) s hould figure in the test report. The composition of helium gas should be as per this specification. Note:- 1. An email requisition will be generated for supply of Helium gas. 2. The vendor should supply the installment within one month from the date of requisition with out violating the total delivery period of 3 months. 3. The vendor should confirm their ability to supply the installment within 7 days from the dat e of requisition. . 5.
